verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email-marketing platform, since self-hostable alternatives exist in the category, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the core Mailchimp marketing product can be self-hosted: its API is served from api.mailchimp.com. The open-source Open Commerce stack is a separate commerce product, not the core email product, and users moving to Mautic is a workaround outside Mailchimp, so neither earns credit.
